comparison_name: 공통 다중 드론 탐색 파이프라인에서 관측 가치 함수 비교

gimbal_scan.model: common periodic lower/upper scan; physical pitch recorded each tick

error_model.name: d455_inspired_optimistic
error_model.description: Optimistic virtual depth observations inspired by public D455-class specifications, not a device reproduction
error_model.range_convention: optical_Z; actual ray length is used for smoke integration and map ray caps
error_model.public_sigma: observed-Z sigma with maximum geometry and configured degradation factors plus known outlier mixture variance and bias variance; no true error/T/normal/outlier flag

fire_smoke.model: solid-masked dimensionless diffusion; fixed pre-existing smoke, shared temporal modulation

motion.stop_rule: stop at first originally planned rest point whose complete future hover is jointly reservation-safe

candidates.route_prefilter: none; test every candidate; observed-free connectivity rejection only

human.low_surface_band_rule: only confirmed observed planar OCCUPIED cells in partial bottom torso row; measured height +3 empirical std +5mm <= foot height +18cm; unknown and higher body rows unchanged
human.surface_representation: observed representative XY + measured mean Z, empirical scatter, all occupied-hit height maxima; strict mixed-voxel leg/body checks

communication: instantaneous shared observed map and planned trajectories
common_prior: bounding volume, staging free volume, anonymous fixed target regions on all floors; no internal geometry or fire-source coordinates to planner
dynamics: kinematic exact tracking of FUEL Polynomial quintics; no downwash or attitude/controller dynamics
timing: synchronous simulation; component wall times logged separately; no real-time claim
entry_graph_update: before every assignment, same current map version for both policies
pending_utility_update: rescore active endpoints on the same current map, at most 4 additional predictions
sensor_change_only: New fixed multistorey geometry, independent reference, observed-free candidate heights and source-local smoke; identical utility/assignment/motion/human dimensions across policies
evaluation_regions: whole interior floor region per room, inset5cm; actual1.85m entry opening centre region width1.2m; fixed before policy comparison

input_provenance.assumption: continue with the previously approved ten large-fire buildings and existing common settings; repair only missing bottom landings
input_provenance.new_request_received_through: section2 common candidate generation and candidate limits
